verdict.rationale: Pricing docs list Account and Contact management, which covers companies and contacts, and say AI syncs emails, events, and contacts, which implies activities are captured against records. Neither item documents the linking between contacts and accounts or a per-record activity timeline, and no independent or hands-on source corroborates either. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of contact-to-account linked records, a documented full activity timeline view on each record, independent or hands-on corroboration.
